answer: By the umber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The grove holds work receipts rather than names, so the beacon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
